verdict.rationale: Clerk shows only thin signs of API versioning: a versioned Backend API path (GET /v1/logs) and a docs page on pinning a Clerk SDK to a specific version. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, timelines or a versioning scheme. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy and sunset timelines, explicit API versioning docs (version headers, dated versions, or migration guides), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The GET /v1/logs endpoint is now public
